channel.title: AI GridWatch — Rhode Island data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Rhode Island, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Charlestown: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Adopted unanimously (5-0); data centers and battery energy storage systems not permitted in any zoning district. Second RI town to ban data centers after Smithfield. No active proposals at time of vote; preemptive action citing Quonset and Smithfield controversies. Planning Commission unanimously endorsed in July.

item.title: Westerly: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Adopted 7-0; one-year moratorium on development or construction of data centers. Allows Planning and Zoning Commission time to draft comprehensive zoning rules. Town ordinances were previously silent on data centers. No pending applications at time of vote.

item.description: Adopted 4-1 May 5, effective Jun 4; data centers not permitted in any zoning district
